//: rust-analyzer only discovers workspace members. Everything excluded from
the workspace has to be listed here or the editor treats it as plain text.
The firmware and the probes are excluded because they are no_std for
riscv32imc and cannot compile for the host; the bench rig is excluded
because btleplug wants system libraries the product does not.
Each excluded directory carries its own rust-analyzer.toml naming its
target. If your editor still fights, open firmware/vag-dash-fw as its own
window — one target per window is what rust-analyzer is happiest with.
